svg.title: The review gate has three dispositions
svg.desc: Give the review gate three genuinely different destinations. Resumption, required changes and continued pause must not share the same success symbol. Visual distinction: A docket slot beside a raised review desk and a closed stop arm. Review is a decision process; no approval is implied. A bounded workload tray with a large pause pair and a stop bar. A temporary operational disposition, not a breached wall or permanent destruction. Three unconnected output trays with neutral alternating shading. Holds resumed, change-required and paused outcomes without coding them as moral success or failure.
